scripts.build: deno task --cwd packages/ui build && cargo build -p control-plane --features server
scripts.build:prod: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml build ui control-plane-ui
scripts.lint: deno task --cwd packages/ui lint && cargo clippy -p control-plane --features server -- -D warnings
scripts.typecheck: deno task --cwd packages/ui typecheck && cargo check -p control-plane --features server
